verdict.rationale: Factory offers session lifecycle/message management via API and cloud session sync so sessions are viewable from any browser, and 'Software Factory' provides an automation coverage map of the delivery lifecycle, implying some visibility into agent activity. However, there's no explicit documentation of a live status feed, streaming logs, or real-time 'what is the agent doing now' view. missing for 10: explicit real-time status/log streaming UI, documented notification of current step/tool-call, independent hands-on confirmation of live monitoring.
